papers.headline: OGLE-2016-BLG-0523: A Low-mass Brown Dwarf or super-Jupiter in a >100 au Orbit
papers.summary: To search for very wide-orbit binary-lens events, we cross-match microlensing events detected by OGLE-IV and KMTNet between 2011 and 2024.
papers.title: OGLE-2016-BLG-0523: A Low-mass Brown Dwarf or super-Jupiter in a >100 au Orbit

papers.headline: Adiabatic evolution of hadronic neutron stars
papers.summary: In this paper we compute several structural properties of static and rotating neutron stars, considering both rigid and differential rotation.
papers.title: Adiabatic evolution of hadronic neutron stars

papers.headline: A Comprehensive JWST Slitless Spectroscopic Census of ∼12,000 Emission-Line Galaxies at Redshift 0∼9 in COSMOS
papers.summary: Emission-line galaxies provide key diagnostics of star formation, chemical enrichment, and AGN activity across cosmic time.
papers.title: A Comprehensive JWST Slitless Spectroscopic Census of ∼12,000 Emission-Line Galaxies at Redshift 0∼9 in COSMOS
